name: Magic, Science and Religion
description: In this course students will explore and critique Max Weber’s proposition that magic and religion will inevitably decline as a result of scientific advancement and modernization. Is this true? Does scientific advancement lead to the disappearance of magic and religion? How does science displace these older forms of knowledge? How do magic and religion continue to exist and sometimes thrive within modernity? Do unscientific types of rationality still play an important role in modern life?
